Job title:  Mobile Podiatrist 

  Job type:  Contractor position, flexible working hours 

  Job setting:  Community and home visits 

  Salary offer:  $100 – $120 per session  (depending on experience) 

  Location:  Melbourne 

   

  About the company:   

 Our client is a well-established allied health provider delivering high-quality, home-based services across NSW since 2018 and now expanding into VIC. Their multidisciplinary team includes physiotherapists, occupational therapists, exercise physiologists, remedial massage therapists, and other allied health professionals, all working collaboratively to deliver personalised, client-centred care. 

 At the heart of their approach is the belief that everyone deserves access to quality healthcare in the comfort of their own home. They are committed to supporting independence, mobility, and meaningful participation in daily activities—whether that’s returning to hobbies, staying active, or spending time with family. All services are delivered in line with best-practice, evidence-informed care. 

   

  About the role:  

 Our client is seeking an experienced Contract Podiatrists to join their mobile community team in Melbourne. This is a contractor-based opportunity providing Podiatry services in clients’ homes—there is no clinic work and no aged care component. 

 You will be responsible for managing your own schedule while delivering high-quality podiatric care to an adult caseload in a mobile setting. Referrals are provided, and appointments are flexible and self-managed, allowing you full autonomy over your working days and hours. 

 This role is ideal for a clinician who values independence, flexibility, and the ability to focus on patient care without administrative burden. 

   

  Benefits:  

 
	 Contractor role with full flexibility over your schedule 
	 Competitive contractor rate: $100 – $120 per session (45–60 minutes) 
	 Referral-based workload (no self-sourcing required) 
	 Flexible working arrangements – choose your own days and hours 
	 Minimal admin burden with full back-end support provided 
	 Opportunity to work in a growing, well-supported mobile allied health team 
	 Focus on clinical work only – no clinic attendance required 
	 Autonomy to manage your caseload and working style 
 

   

  Requirements:  

 
	 Minimum 2–3 years of post-graduate podiatry experience 
	 Experience in community-based or mobile Podiatry preferred 
	 Strong clinical skills in adult Podiatric care 
	 Ability to work independently and manage a mobile caseload 
	 Commitment to evidence-based, patient-centred care 
	 Full AHPRA registration as a Podiatrist 
	 Full Australian working rights 
	 Own vehicle and willingness to travel for home visits (car allowance provided for permanent staff) 
 

 This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Podiatrist seeking a highly flexible contractor role within a supportive mobile allied health service, with the freedom to structure your work a   Apply Now

Our commitment to training and working with only the best companies has been going strong since 2005. We are currently looking for Heavy Diesel Mechanics / HD Fitter with the below experience. 

Duties:

Servicing, maintenance and repair with various Mobile Plant equipment
Troubleshooting mechanical and electrical faults
Attending breakdowns onsite
Repair and maintain the hydraulic components of diesel and petrol/gas engines
Component change outs

Skills and Experience Required:

Strong focus on safety and quality
Proven field service experience
Excellent troubleshooting and diagnostic skills
Own tooling specific to the trade
Experience on Caterpillar, Hitachi and/or Komatsu Mining Equipment
Experience in the mining industry (FIFO)
Certificate III in Mobile Plant Technology / Engineering - Mechanical Trade (Mobile Plant Mechanic) / Heavy Commercial Vehicle Mechanical Technology or similar
Air Conditioning & Refrigeration license (Desirable).
Valid Manual C Class Driver's License

If you are looking to keep at the forefront of technology and earn great money with a company that is well known this could be the job for you.

These positions will be an ongoing, in various locations across Western Australia. Salary will be $80,000 to $120,000 depending on experience.
